titles.romaji: Saitama Bousou Saizensen Flag! Shinimonogurui no Seishun!!
titles.native: 埼玉暴走最前線 フラッグ! 死にものぐるいの青春!!

description: Based on the manga Flag! by Hotta Akio, which was serialized in Young King from 1992 to 1995. The OVA depicts the tumultuous daily lives of three boys, including Noboru, Akira and Haruo, who inherit the flag of the locally famous fugitive tribe "Moonlight".
